definitions: A protocol that allows for the instrumentation, inspection, debugging, and profiling of Chrome, Chromium, and other Blink-based browsers.
A set of APIs used to interact with and control the behavior of web browsers like Chrome.
examples: Developers often use the Chrome DevTools Protocol to automate browser tasks.
Understanding the Chrome DevTools Protocol is key for advanced debugging.
Tools like Puppeteer are built on top of the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
